headline: EPS rises both sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: Yodoko reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥25.90, up 10.4% q/q and up 10.1% y/y.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥25.90 rose 10.4% sequentially from ¥23.47 and 10.1% year-over-year from ¥23.52. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data.
